issues.detail: The initial Stage 07 transport test import failed because tests/test_transport_adapters.py and the transport package did not exist.
issues.resolution: Implemented the three dependency-free transport adapters and added six focused regression tests; the focused and full project suites now pass.

issues.detail: Python 3.11 is unavailable on this workstation.
issues.resolution: Use Python 3.11 grammar parsing plus Python 3.13 execution until a real 3.11 runtime is available.

issues.detail: The approved Stage 07 live launcher could not acquire the SC2 runtime lease because owner_pid=36840, owner_port=5121, and owner_session=cmre_alenger-20260802-124748-6ee40c06 already held it.
issues.resolution: Wait for the existing owner session to release its lease, then rerun the approved launcher and collect CreateGame, JoinGame, runtime listener/heartbeat, and same-window ScriptError evidence. Do not terminate or take over the unknown session.

issues.detail: The requested real-map replay could not obtain an independent approved launcher window. A valid external KeepAlive session owner_pid=27016, runtime_pid=38420, port=5192, session=cmre_alenger-20260802-172211-66826c28 held the global lease throughout the final polling window.
issues.resolution: Do not connect to or terminate the external session. After it releases naturally, rerun the approved launcher on a fresh port, pack that run's staged map directory, then collect CreateGame, JoinGame, RequestStep, raw entities, resource/production events, and a same-window ScriptError verdict.

issues.detail: The adapter had typed ability and transport contracts but no shared explicit route catalog for the basic SC2 command surface.
issues.resolution: Added 19 fixed basic-command routes, typed grouped-unit validation, and simulator-backed move/build/produce regressions. Live transport behavior remains covered by RUNTIME-001.

issues.detail: The foundation proof had test assertions but no inspectable action-and-event replay artifact.
issues.resolution: Generated the adapter-aware simulator replay plus a self-contained minimap-style player with economy and production events. The foundation player remains the command-surface proof; the state-driven macro player is now the economy/production proof. Browser checks cover canvas rendering, timeline seeking, playback, speed controls, filtering, selection, and raw context inspection.

issues.detail: The first full-map player used a terminal-style legacy observation with 159 P1 entities and 128 Battlecruisers at loop 0, so it did not represent economy or production progression.
issues.resolution: Retired that opening source and the fixed-schedule merger. The current economy proof uses a clean simulator fixture with Catalog-backed costs, observed income, explicit action lifecycle, and completion events.

issues.detail: The real-map static preview exposed ordinary playback controls even though its JSONL contained only one loop-0 frame.
issues.resolution: The generated player now detects STATIC_PREVIEW or a static single-frame payload, labels it as non-playable, and disables playback, frame stepping, speed, and seeking. Multi-frame simulator/runtime payloads retain active controls.

issues.detail: The playable simulator replay used a sparse abstract grid and did not visually carry the real map's minimap and full Objects layer.
issues.resolution: The replay generator can embed the real map record, render all 1319 Objects with owner colors, show them in the entity table, and project simulator dynamics around the P1 start area for display only. Timeline and economy behavior remain simulator-backed.

issues.detail: The previous progression replay added entities from a fixed schedule and could not prove resource collection, production buildings, or completion lifecycle.
issues.resolution: Replaced it with a clean state-driven fixture using the public simulator transport and M7 Catalog. The replay starts with only 1 CommandCenter and 8 SCVs, assigns workers to mineral/gas nodes, saves for structures, and records simulator-observed SCV, SupplyDepot, Barracks, Refinery, and Marine completions. The local simulator requires Refinery placement in a free slot while gas collection uses the declared geyser node; this limitation is explicit in the planner comment and replay metadata.

issues.detail: After the first Depot completed, the supply policy retried a second Depot at the same fixed coordinate and produced repeated occupied-placement failures.
issues.resolution: The planner now requests a Depot only while none exists or is active. The regenerated first-night replay has 29/29 completed actions and 0 failed actions.

issues.detail: The prior replay stopped after the macro acceptance point at loop 1056, leaving night=0, terminated=false, and no mission victory.
issues.resolution: The runner now continues through MissionEngine with map-derived first-night timing, wave events, public mission state, and a survive_first_night objective. The final state reaches loop 10081 with night=1, nights_survived=1, terminated=true, and end_reason=all_objectives_success.

issues.detail: The first full-strength replay lost the CommandCenter during Night 3 because dynamic wave units retained full catalog weapon damage, and the policy froze the economy when static structures were seen as base threats.
issues.resolution: Added explicit per-entity dynamic enemy damage scaling, filtered static structures from policy threat observations, and kept workers on the economy loop. The final difficulty-scaled replay reaches all six nights and all objectives successfully.

issues.detail: Recording a full entity census for every combat event made the self-contained player unnecessarily large and delayed control initialization.
issues.resolution: The runner now samples entity frames at the configured replay interval while aggregating every simulator event into the sampled frame. The player timeline marks mission, wave, construction, production, and cleanup events without creating one DOM marker per damage event.

issues.detail: Static map-record tests imported the live SC2 capture module eagerly and failed when optional aiohttp runtime dependencies were unavailable.
issues.resolution: The live capture module is now loaded only by runtime probe functions; static map metadata and simulator replay imports remain dependency-light without changing the live launcher path.

issues.detail: The real-map replay generators replaced ObjectUnit@Id with an enumeration index, so dynamic simulator entities and source-map structures could not be joined back to the original map.
issues.resolution: The shared map_alignment parser preserves source_object_id and source_map_id as map-<ObjectUnit@Id>; footprint-center tolerance binding now covers all 30 finite simulator structure targets, and every structure-destroyed event in the final replay carries the same source identity.

issues.detail: The browser always drew every static Object even after a simulator structure-destroyed event, making destroyed enemy buildings appear alive forever.
issues.resolution: The player accumulates source-linked infested_structure_destroyed events by frame, renders the matching static object as a destroyed cross-marked remnant, and exposes destroyed in the entity table.

issues.detail: Map geometry was duplicated as unvalidated 16..176 and 48..208 literals in multiple replay paths, while the extractor separately reported an Object coordinate envelope.
issues.resolution: MapInfo dimensions, terrain grid dimensions, minimap content bounds, world bounds, coordinate orientation, and placement markers are now generated once and embedded in both replay entry points.

issues.detail: The map-aligned full replay initially exceeded the validation window because the adapter rebuilt command/event bookkeeping on every loop; the higher-density run also exposed fixed-prefix building reinforcement selection.
issues.resolution: The adapter regains control at policy/map-event/replay boundaries while the simulator still executes every underlying loop, separates wave density from enemy damage, throttles daytime structure pushes, selects live source buildings for reinforcements, and completes a fresh six-night victory at loop 63840.

issues.detail: The replay extracted named normal, special, and cooperative force calls but omitted the persistent AIWhiteNoiseSpawning and delayed HybridReinforcements services that create substantial night pressure.
issues.resolution: MapScript extraction now emits white-noise quota/cooldown/inheritance and Hybrid per-night profiles; the replay projects 52 white-noise cycles, 6 Hybrid waves, building-local spawn positions, and visible event kinds. The final Stank branch reaches all six nights and destroys all 30 source-linked objective structures.

residual_risks.detail: No live Neuro WebSocket, Bank-in-game action/context, or real-SC2 transport effect is claimed until RUNTIME-001 is cleared and G4 passes.
